# Monitoring brief: Lumwana-area open-pit mine

**Pair:** nominal 2023-08-12 to 2023-09-02 (robust CVA, 3 visible bands). *Mock brief for development; the live API builds this from the database.*

## Headline

- **413 ha** changed (1.56% of the AOI) in **215** polygons.
- **81%** of the change lies inside the mine footprint.

## By facility

| Facility | Changed (ha) | Share of facility | Main change |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Tailings storage facility | 193.6 | 8.6% | tailings deposition |
| South pit complex | 37.7 | 1.9% | pit excavation |
| Eastern waste dumps | 36.2 | 8.3% | waste dumping |
| North-west pit complex | 33.6 | 3.0% | waste dumping |
| Process plant and central yard | 4.9 | 2.5% | infrastructure or settlement |
| South-west settlement | 1.3 | 0.1% | pit excavation |
| Eastern camp | 0.0 | 0.0% | - |
| Fresh-water dam | 0.0 | 0.0% | - |

## Watch list

- Tailings deposition dominates the storage facility; check beach width against the permit.
- New waste dumping at the pit edges is the second-largest class.
- Change outside the register is mostly seasonal vegetation and burn, not expansion.
